title: Rav Shmuel of Tuach

paragraphs: [Niddah 33a](https://www.sefaria.org/Niddah.33b.6-11) relates that Rav Papa came to Bei Tuach and asked: “Is there a young scholar here whom I may enter and greet?” An old woman answered: “There is a young scholar here, named Rav Shmuel, who recites baraitot. May you be like him!” Rav Papa inferred that he was God-fearing and went to see him. Rav Shmuel slaughtered an ox in his honor, then asked Rav Papa about two contradictory mishnayot. Rav Papa answered: “Here we are dealing with a Samaritan who observes the purity laws.” He replied: “Would you make such a Samaritan a man who has intercourse with a menstruant?” Rav Papa left and came before Rav Shimi bar Ashi, who asked why he had not answered him, etc.

notes.text: The linked account begins with Rav Papa asking to greet a scholar. The blessing comes from the older woman, and Rav Papa takes it as a sign that Rav Shmuel is God-fearing.
Hyman cites 33a. The link opens 33b, where Rav Shmuel raises the difficulty and objects to Rav Papa’s reply. Rav Shimi bar Ashi then asks why Rav Papa did not offer a different answer.
